audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers give Gangplank levels 2 and 3 and call level 6 even, while their own why text says Akshan out-pokes you through 2-3 and picks the fight at 6. Packet chart says Akshan on all three rows.
audit.why: whys[1] and whys[2] state the second Avengerang point chips you twice from outside your range while your keg is on cooldown; whys[4] states Comeuppance plus Heroic Swing let him choose or leave the fight and that Cannon Barrage zones but does not duel. Those are Akshan rows.
audit.corrected: Level 2, Level 3 and Level 6 flip to Akshan in both layers, ratings adjusted, proposed as one atomic chart group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's spike list is generic and puts nothing real at level 6; the content layer has the correct story but the full layer contradicts it.
audit.why: Akshan's spikes are the second Avengerang rank (9/8/7/6/5s, hits out and back from 850) and Comeuppance at 6 (100/85/70s, missing-health damage). Yours are Sheen/Essence Reaver, where empowered Parrrley detonating a chain bursts a no-resist target through the Dirty Fighting shield, and the 2-item window. He does not reclaim the game later, which is why surviving the early poke is the whole plan.
audit.corrected: phases[1].why and phases[4].why rewritten to the real spikes; the level chart moved to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer names only Heroic Swing and describes it as a 'dash + camera swing escape'. Avengerang, Dirty Fighting, Going Rogue and Comeuppance never appear, and nothing states the terrain requirement.
audit.why: Heroic Swing fires a grappling hook into terrain — it cannot be used in open ground, and he is knocked off on colliding with champions or terrain, so the anchor wall is the decisive object in this lane. Dirty Fighting shields him on every third hit, which is what your chain has to break through. Going Rogue is camouflage: Gangplank has no reveal in his kit, so vision is mandatory.
audit.corrected: Stated the terrain anchor in dosFull[0].d and report[5].t, the shield in dosFull[2].d, the camouflage-vision requirement in tldr and dontsFull[2].d, and put the real cooldowns into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing warned that your kegs are shootable from range in this specific matchup.
audit.why: Avengerang reaches 850 and his passive fires an extra attack, so a keg placed in front of you is free to deny — this is why keg placement, not keg timing, is the early-lane rule here.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[0].d now says place kegs behind you because he shoots them from 850.

edits.before: Weather the poke — barrel his approach and cleanse the Heroic Swing setup. Gangplank wins the Heroic Swing cooldown windows.
edits.after: Weather Avengerang's out-and-back poke, keg his swing anchors, and carry a sweeper — Going Rogue is camouflage you cannot see.

edits.before: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — His dash + camera swing escape. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Heroic Swing: 18s at rank 1 and it must anchor to terrain, so fight him in open ground. - Avengerang: 9s, damage going out and coming back. - Going Rogue: camouflage, hold a Control Ward. - Cannon Barrage: 160s.

edits.before: His dash + camera swing escape. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It anchors to terrain (18s at rank 1) — in open ground he has no wall to swing from.

edits.before: Akshan wastes Heroic Swing — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Dirty Fighting shields him every third hit — a keg chain blows through it.

edits.before: That is Akshan's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Kegs have low HP and Avengerang reaches 850 — place them behind you, not ahead.

edits.before: Letting him pop your barrels for free — every broken keg is gold and tempo handed across the lane.
edits.after: Going Rogue is camouflage and you have no reveal — without a Control Ward you miss the roam.

edits.before: Track Akshan's Heroic Swing: His dash + camera swing escape. Engage when it's down. When it is down — Barrel chain + Q cash-out.
edits.after: Heroic Swing must anchor to terrain — put kegs on his wall anchors so the grapple drags him into the blast, then chain.

edits.before: First barrel chains start zoning his wave positions. Only take the trade when Akshan's Heroic Swing is down.
edits.after: His second Avengerang point chips you twice a cast from 850 while your lone keg sits low-HP and free for him to shoot.

edits.before: Cannon Barrage wins fights you are not even in — watch the map. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Akshan's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Comeuppance plus Heroic Swing lets him pick a sidelane fight or swing clear of Cannon Barrage, which zones ground but never duels.
